### Family Tree
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/family-tree-one-year-devotions-for-men-august-15.html
Passage: Matthew 1:5
Points:
- Biblical genealogies were essential in ancient times to verify priestly lineage and royal descent.
- Matthew breaks typical ancient custom by including four women with outsider or scandalous backgrounds.
- God intentionally chooses what the world despises to accomplish His redemptive plans.
- Ruth's inclusion shows that true nobility of character and faith matter more than ethnic origins.
- The Lord looks at the condition of the heart rather than worldly standing or past failure.

### Tracing the Genealogy of Jesus
Author: R.C. Sproul
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/tracing-genealogy-jesus
Passage: Matthew 1:16
Points:
- Biblical genealogies ground the gospel message directly within verifiable human history.
- Matthew emphasizes Jesus' legal descent from David and Abraham to establish His messianic kingship.
- Luke records Jesus' physical lineage back to Adam to demonstrate the universal scope of salvation.
- Jesus fulfills the covenant promises to Israel while standing as the new Adam who redeems all nations.

### What's in a Genealogy?
Author: Guy Richard
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/whats-in-a-genealogy
Passage: Luke 3:23-31
Points:
- Luke deliberately places the genealogy between Jesus' baptism and His testing in the wilderness.
- Tracing Christ's roots back to Adam highlights His genuine humanity and connection to all people.
- The wilderness temptations of Jesus parallel the original temptations faced by Adam in Genesis 3.
- Where Adam failed and brought condemnation, Christ conquered temptation and Satan completely.
- Through Jesus' obedience and victory, believers receive forgiveness, grace, and reconciliation with God.

### Jesus' Family Tree
Author: Joel Beeke
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-family-tree
Passage: Matthew 1:1-23
Points:
- Matthew's genealogical record demonstrates God's unbroken covenant faithfulness across generations.
- Christ stepped into the line of fallen humanity, taking on our nature while remaining without sin.
- The inclusion of notorious sinners and foreigners proves that no one is beyond Jesus' saving reach.
- Jesus broke the destructive cycle of human depravity to adopt repentant sinners into His family.
- As Immanuel, Christ fully understands our weaknesses and serves as our gracious Savior.
